name: registry-mcp
displayName: Company Check — UK, Sweden & Norway business registers
description: Check a company before you deal with it. Bundles the hosted Company Check MCP server (Companies House, Bolagsverket, Brønnøysundregistrene — read-only, no key) with a skill that teaches the counterparty, filing-deadline and register-coverage workflows, and three commands: /check-supplier, /filing-deadlines and /enrich-company-list.
